context_for_next_testing_agent: Forgot Password feature fully implemented and tested. Three new endpoints: POST /api/auth/forgot-password (sends reset email), GET /api/auth/verify-reset-token (validates token), POST /api/auth/reset-password (resets password). Frontend pages: /forgot-password and /reset-password with proper validation. Reset tokens expire after 1 hour. Email enumeration attack prevented by always returning success message. All existing auth features still working.
